scenarios.task_shape: A material investigation discovers an expensive cross-contract invariant; a target decision owner accepts it and a fresh related task starts later.
required_outcomes: historical engineering evidence remains separate from canonical authority
human promotion disposition names the decision owner and canonical update
initial routing supplies the accepted current item from a bounded shard
the fresh executor reads the canonical owner before relying on the summary
the later task receipt records delivered guidance IDs and content digests
the later task records whether guidance was used rejected stale or inapplicable
the routing index reaches reuse-observed only from explicit later-task evidence
forbidden_outcomes: promotion record treated as canonical owner

scenarios.task_shape: A registered project decision owner records an accepted development rule without a preceding engineering discovery.
required_outcomes: decision authority and scope are verified
a durable decision reference is retained
the registered canonical owner is updated before routing
the derived guidance route identifies decision-owner-directive origin
forbidden_outcomes: arbitrary human chat treated as project authority
empty engineering evidence misrepresented as a discovery
routing projection treated as canonical owner

scenarios.task_shape: The initial request identifies an area and dependency; source inspection later identifies a concrete fact ID and symbol.
required_outcomes: initial selection uses area subsystem architecture item or dependency rather than task profile alone
refined selection uses changed fact path symbol architecture relationship contract or issue evidence
both stages obey separate packet limits and produce a context receipt

scenarios.task_shape: A current accepted item references a canonical owner whose content digest changed after the last review.
required_outcomes: current claim rejected
item becomes revalidation-required
digest change does not infer the replacement fact

scenarios.task_shape: Two applicable retained conclusions conflict about one registered fact.
required_outcomes: reciprocal conflict relationship
definitive answer blocked
conflict routed to the registered decision owner
both provenance chains preserved

scenarios.task_shape: An accepted decision replaces an older retained constraint.
required_outcomes: reciprocal supersedes and superseded-by links
replacement remains current only after owner and freshness validation
older item remains historical

scenarios.task_shape: A target decision owner narrows one accepted development rule for a bounded project area.
required_outcomes: base guidance ID and matching fact type are retained
scope authority rationale validation and revalidation triggers are explicit
target fact-type ownership decides precedence
expired or absent exception grants no permission

scenarios.task_shape: A project area has incomplete guidance routing coverage.
required_outcomes: coverage is classified as known-gap or unknown
known gap names evidence and missing owner or guidance
mapped coverage references existing guidance IDs
forbidden_outcomes: missing route interpreted as no project rule

scenarios.task_shape: The same bounded task is presented through multiple supported assistant surfaces.
required_outcomes: same canonical authority
same protected boundaries
same required validation
same unresolved human decisions
implementation strategy may differ
a separate human walkthrough preserves the same constraints without being counted as assistant runtime conformance
forbidden_outcomes: human walkthrough claimed as assistant conformance

scenarios.task_shape: A later task is run from equivalent source state with and without a reviewed knowledge route.
required_outcomes: same later-task request acceptance criteria and validation
fresh execution surface per run
observable orientation dependency archaeology repeated invariant explanation timing supplied-versus-reconstructed context and quality metrics
unknown values preserved when the provider cannot expose them
forbidden_outcomes: quality regression hidden by lower context cost
